core.title: C Shape Door Pull, First Impressions C75x34

text.description_html:
First Impressions 75 Inch "C" Door Pull

This sleek 75" high pull is great for entry doors, commercial doors, or storefront doors. They are available as back to back, surface or thru-bolt mounting.

This "C" Door Pull is available in other sizes and finishes, Contact Us for more information.

Impeccably crafted from high grade 1/2" thick non rusting anodized aluminum and finished matte clear.

Specifications: of First Impressions "C" Door Pull

  • Overall Height: 75-3/16"
  • Overall Width of C: 34-5/16"
  • Thickness: 1/2"
  • Width of pull: 2"

Note: This beautiful door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door). Optional Surface mounting or Back to Back mounting available (Pulls bolt to each other - Requires 2 door pulls).

*Sold individually (1 door pull).
